parameters.name: corporation_id
parameters.description: Filter by the Corporation whose group policy the proposal targets

parameters.name: proposer
parameters.description: Proposals whose proposers[] includes this account

parameters.name: pending_voter
parameters.description: Only SUBMITTED proposals within their voting period where this account is a current group member that has not voted yet

parameters.name: At-Block-Height
parameters.description: Header to query historical state at a specific block height. When provided, returns the state as it was when the specified block finished processing. When omitted, returns the latest indexed state. Must be a positive integer not exceeding the current indexed block height.
